album.title: you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love [Explicit]

wiki.summary: “purple” is the seventh track from Olivia Rodrigo’s third studio album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love. Olivia initially teased the track in an interview with Cosmopolitan: "There’s still some purple in my life—let’s just say that. I won’t give too much away but there’s still some purple." Read more on Last.fm.
